description: Step 17 cards whose complete currently-modeled behavior is explicitly covered by repository regression tests. This is intentionally conservative; absence means partial/unreviewed, not broken.

arch-memnite.notes: Base-characteristic artifact creature with no additional rules text

arch-yargle-and-multani.notes: Base-characteristic legendary creature with no additional rules text

arch-disenchant.notes: Single authoritative destroy effect with artifact/enchantment target restriction

arch-rampant-growth.notes: Single basic-land search effect to the battlefield tapped followed by shuffle

esika.notes: Both modal DFC cast faces, front-face mana/static abilities, Bridge upkeep reveal-until behavior, face persistence, and command-zone face selection are covered by release regressions and the Step 35 golden contract.
